# The Intelligent Hoodlums

> The Intelligent Hoodlums is an education company from Las Vegas, working with schools nationwide, that helps teachers solve problems through professional development, consulting, and conferences. It was founded in 2014 by two teachers turned instructional designers, Mike Lang and webs.

The Intelligent Hoodlums is an education company for teachers. The name is unrelated to the 1990s rapper Intelligent Hoodlum. The company builds professional development teachers can use on Monday, and systems a school can run without outside help. Its Classroom OS series teaches educators to plan with ai while keeping their own judgment in charge. Principals and district leaders hire the Hoodlums for PD, conferences, and consulting.

The founders:

- Mike Lang is an Apple Distinguished Educator, a PBS Digital Innovator, and a Heart of Education Award winner, with eighteen years of teaching across Mississippi, Taiwan, and Las Vegas.
- webs (Stephanie Weber) is a learning scientist and developer in Las Vegas. She runs studio w labs, co-founded Understory Collaborative, and co-founded The Intelligent Hoodlums with Mike Lang. She spent ten years in the Clark County School District and is finishing a PhD at UNLV.

## Classroom OS

- [Classroom OS](https://theintelligenthoodlums.com/classroom-os): the first five-day teacher series, June 1 to 5, 2026, in Las Vegas, and what four crews of teachers built.
- [ClassroomOS Bootcamp, Volume 2](https://theintelligenthoodlums.com/classroom-os-volume-2): the in-person series at Ed W. Von Tobel Middle School, July 20 to 24, 2026.
- [ClassroomOS, Vol. III](https://theintelligenthoodlums.com/classroom-os-volume-3): a virtual cohort, one hour every Wednesday for nine weeks, with five contact units.
